description: The owner state (requires the token edm_… or the account session): account or guest, the notice e-mail, the allowance and the secret whsec_… that signs each webhook (Standard Webhooks: webhook-id, webhook-timestamp, webhook-signature). Each webhook POST carries `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp` (Unix seconds) and `webhook-signature: v1,<base64>`: HMAC-SHA256 of `id.timestamp.body` with the key of your `whsec_…` (the base64 after the prefix). This is the Standard Webhooks pattern: any of its libraries can check it; reject a timestamp outside 5 minutes. After `POST /api/dono/segredo`, the previous secret still signs for 24 h (two `v1,` parts in the header).
name: get_owner
title: Owner
